decisions.statement: A catalog changes when the game does rather than while a reader is looking.
A catalog is asked for once a browser session and held in this module.
A navigation inside the app reuses the held catalogs rather than asking again.
No HTTP cache would have held a catalog.
The row ceiling is well above the largest catalog.
The store answers a page's declared keys under both spellings.
The store stamps an entry with an id the catalog types do not name.
Narrowing a row to the keys named makes the assertion true.
Narrowing a row keeps the row small.

definition: the catalogs a completion tab reads its totals from
